_doc: Shared cases for the `segments` parity pair's catalogue matcher (#1308, decisions § 2402, laps § 2463): apps/web/src/lib/segments/segments.test.ts and apps/mobile_android/test/segments_test.dart both read this table. Track fixes carry `t`, seconds after `base_time`; `off_track` marks a fix the distance estimator kept off the line. Lines are gate_crossing v1 gates. `expect` is null for no effort; `time_seconds` is compared within 0.001 s and `started_offset_ms` exactly. Expected values were computed from the path each track samples, not by running the matcher.

cases.name: interpolated time: both crossings fall between fixes
a segment with no lines falls back to the circles
a segment with only a start line falls back to the circles
off-track fixes are excluded: one 300 m off the line would break the length guard
a checkpoint on the line is passed under the lines rule
a checkpoint 60 m off the run refuses it under the lines rule
a parallel path 20 m away does not match (the 35 m circles would)
the same parallel path is matched by the circles when the segment has no lines
the wrong direction does not match
a run that starts on the start line never crosses it, and the circles do not step in
a sparse track (15 s between fixes) is still timed by interpolation
a gap over 60 s across a line is no crossing
a hairpin: start and end lines 40 m apart on opposite carriageways
two passes: the faster second pass is the effort
a start crossed again after a short loop back: the later start counts
a loop segment (start and end on one line): one lap
a loop run three times: every lap is timed and the finish of one starts the next, so lap 2 (80 s, between laps of 133 s and 100 s) is the effort
a loop run three times with its start and end lines apart: the end line 100 m before the start, every lap timed, lap 2 (60 s, between 100 s and 75 s) is the effort
